gnome-boxes.description: Unofficial. A simple GNOME application to access virtual machines.

pcsx2.description: PCSX2 is a free and open-source PlayStation 2 (PS2) emulator, using a combination of MIPS CPU Interpreters, Recompilers and a Virtual Machine which manages hardware states and PS2 system memory. This allows you to play PS2 games on your PC, with many additional features and benefits.

pcsx2-nightly.description: PCSX2 is a free and open-source PlayStation 2 (PS2) emulator, using a combination of MIPS CPU Interpreters, Recompilers and a Virtual Machine which manages hardware states and PS2 system memory. This allows you to play PS2 games on your PC, with many additional features and benefits. This is the nightly version.

qemu.description: Unofficial. A generic and open source machine & userspace emulator and virtualizer, to run a virtual machines.

qemu-ppc.description: Run PowerPC operating systems on 64-bit Intel Linux hosts.

quickgui.description: An elegant virtual machine manager for the desktop.

scummvm.description: Unofficial. A 'virtual machine' for several classic graphical point-and-click adventure games

virt-manager.description: Unofficial. Desktop interface for managing virtual machines through libvirt.

virtualbox.description: Powerful x86 virtualization for enterprise as well as home use.
